steps.name: preflight
steps.command: git fetch --prune origin && test $(git rev-parse origin/develop) = 9d64c8ea61909349e307596753dd2444ad00a775 && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

steps.name: quality
steps.command: cd interface && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run quality:frontend

steps.name: publish
steps.command: git diff --check && git add interface && git commit -m 'Fix frontend quality debt' && git fetch origin develop && test $(git rev-parse origin/develop) = 9d64c8ea61909349e307596753dd2444ad00a775 && git push origin HEAD:develop && git rev-parse HEAD
